messages:
Noah: Hypothetical emergency time-capsule question: If you could bring back one discontinued candy or snack for a single week, what would it be? Bonus points for why or a photo :candy:
Sofia: Dunkaroos frosting packs. Unapologetic nostalgia. :heart_eyes:
Jared: Surge soda. That citrus rush was unfairly removed from my life. :zap:
Maya: PB Max — peanut butter + chocolate bars that somehow disappeared. I still dream. :yum:
Ava: Squeeze Pops! The grape ones. I had a ritual: poke, lick, repeat. :sweat_smile:
Sofia: Also petitioning for Olestra-free Pringles flavors... anyone? :raised_hands:
Jared: I would throw a week-long SnackFest and hoard all of them. :partying_face:
Noah: Adding a tiny poll: who votes for Dunkaroos? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
DevBot: Poll created — https://polls.internal/3098765432 — results in 24h
Maya: If Dunkaroos wins, I will bake cookies inspired by the frosting. Deal? :cookie:
Ava: Deal. I will bring vintage lunchbox stickers as prize money. :trophy:
Sofia: Also curious regional picks: anyone want to share a local discontinued gem? Short answer ok!
Jared: UK had chocolate bars called 'Wispa' — they brought it back once, but that was a tease. :cry:
Noah: Love the regional nostalgia. Thanks for sharing, team — this made my coffee break. :coffee:
